label: PLAYORA crypto payments and service protection — 7 October 2026
text:
Orders are priced in USD and paid directly in USDT using the selected BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20), TRON (TRC-20) or Solana (SPL) route. There is no customer wallet or account top-up. Use only the exact asset, network, address, amount and any memo shown by your authenticated checkout. USDT on these networks is not interchangeable when sending a transfer.

The exchange-rate mode is fixed for the provider's valid quote. The local checkout window is 30 minutes, but it does not extend the provider's shorter quote or address validity. Follow the displayed expiry and never send to expired instructions. Availability, minimum amounts and network conditions are checked for the selected route. PLAYORA pays the provider processing fees; wallet or exchange sending fees charged directly to you remain your responsibility. Make sure the full displayed payment amount reaches the checkout destination.

Payment is complete only after provider evidence is verified and allocated to your order. A screenshot or transaction hash alone is not proof of payment. Underpayments, excess or duplicate transfers, late payments and wrong-route payments require review. Do not send additional funds without fresh authenticated instructions. Provider or network delays never simulate a successful payment, and a late transfer cannot reserve stock already sold. Contact support if anything is unclear; never share a seed phrase or private key.

The accepted package or order defines every rank, win-rate, hero, role, quantity, delivery and other service condition. If PLAYORA fails an agreed deliverable or condition, you are entitled to a 100% refund of the affected order's purchase amount; partial work does not reduce it. A repeat service, replacement or extension is optional when a refund is due. If an account is reclaimed, restricted, unusable or lacks promised access and review confirms the buyer did not cause the issue, the same full-refund protection applies. Completion alone does not end account protection. Verified account damage caused by our team is assessed for fair monetary compensation separately from the order refund, without automatically capping it at the order price or making an undisputed refund depend on agreement about compensation.

For completed boosting and shop orders, the standard in-app dispute window is 365 days after completion. Account listings retain their separately accepted in-app reporting window. An in-app appeal may be submitted within 30 days of a decision, up to 3 appeals. These interface limits do not remove the refund, account-protection or compensation rights in your accepted terms or any applicable legal rights. If an in-app option is unavailable or its window has ended, contact your order's support conversation or support@playoragames.com for staff review. Existing accepted orders retain their own terms. Support is available 24/7.

remedies.cancellation: You can cancel for a full refund before fulfillment starts. If you change your mind after correctly performed work starts, only a properly disclosed, lawful, pre-agreed charge for work actually supplied may apply. Without that agreed basis, PLAYORA does not invent a deduction. Cancellation rules never reduce a full refund owed for an unfulfilled agreement, protected account problem or applicable legal right.
remedies.partial_work: If PLAYORA fails an agreed deliverable or condition, the affected order receives a 100% refund even if part of the work was completed. We do not deduct partial work, administration or original processing costs. A repair, repeat service, replacement or extension is optional for the customer when a full refund is due.
remedies.no_show: If our team fails an agreed attendance or guaranteed scheduling condition, the full-refund promise applies. If required customer access or availability is missing, we explain the issue and agree how to proceed; we do not silently complete the order or invent a no-show fee. An estimate is not a guaranteed deadline, and a change to an actual guarantee requires customer agreement.
remedies.missed_target: If we miss an accepted rank, win-rate, hero/role restriction, item, quantity, guaranteed deadline or other agreed condition, we refund 100% of the affected order purchase amount. Conditions are defined per package or accepted order, not by a global win-rate target. For account reclamation, bans, restrictions or missing promised access, a full refund applies when review confirms the buyer did not cause the problem. Verified damage caused by our team is reviewed for separate fair monetary compensation under the accepted terms.
remedies.refund_basis: A full refund returns 100% of the purchase payment allocated to the affected order, including charges collected by PLAYORA for it. By default we return the original crypto asset and original number of units allocated to the order. A different supported asset/network or valuation requires the customer's express agreement to the exact amount first. Previous partial refunds count toward that same order total. Excess and duplicate payments are accounted for separately and never become a site balance. Direct third-party wallet/exchange costs and later market-value changes are not part of the order purchase amount; applicable additional rights remain. Confirm a safe recipient asset/network/address with authenticated support; an exchange sending address is not automatically a refund destination.
remedies.refund_fees: PLAYORA pays the outgoing refund fee so it does not reduce an eligible full refund. We do not deduct administration or our original processing costs. PLAYORA also covers outgoing fees on agreed account-damage compensation. Separately charged wallet/exchange sending fees paid directly to third parties are not included in the order purchase amount, without restricting any further remedy required by law. We aim to assess a claim within 72 hours of necessary evidence and initiate an approved refund within 48 hours of confirming a usable destination, respecting any shorter legal deadline. Provider checks or complex reviews receive an explanation and updates at least every 48 hours while action is pending. Completion requires verified transfer evidence.
